checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'editorial-calendar'.

checks.description: Every theme maps to the strategy angle and an SEO cluster.
checks.rule: Each calendar item carries an angle_link and an seo_cluster; no orphan themes.

checks.description: Calendar sets a realistic cadence and a named owner per item.
checks.rule: Output includes a cadence and an owner field on each item.

checks.description: Each item carries theme, mapping, format, date, owner, and status.
checks.rule: Every item includes theme, angle_link, seo_cluster, format, target_date, owner, and status.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: No invented offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name to justify a theme.
checks.rule: Themes reference only offers and titles traceable to the brief; absent ones trigger stop-and-ask, never invention or accreditation claims.

checks.description: Theme framing is empowering, never deficit-framed.
checks.rule: Themes speak to what the reader can build, not to what they lack; no shaming, per brand-voice.md.
